revisions.reason: Review 20261124 interpreter-benchmark local candidates: two experimental LOCAL_CANDIDATE_APPS labels (rude_awakening_ags, simcity_2001_vb), one root constant and two APPS data entries pointing at unchanged archive.org downloads (an AGS 2.70 exe with its generated tree manifest; a VB6 p-code exe with the MSVBVM60.DLL its CAB ships). requiredFiles uses ordinary launcher behavior. No launch arguments, config overlays, registry seeds, callback producer, boundary, export, owner, continuation, EIP/stack/clock write, rendering or input fence change. No gameplay compatibility assertion. General callback ownership remains pending.
